messages:
alex: Hey team — PR #482 (migration guide + SDK snippet) is ready. Need two reviewers and a merge window today. CI preview failed once, but re-ran and it showed up. Can folks take a quick look for style/terminology?

maria: On it. ETA 30m.

jamal: Will check examples and JS snippet for idiomatic usage. Any preferred voice?

alex: We should follow the style guide: second-person imperative for quickstart steps, explanatory voice for concepts. Also enforce terminology: use 'model variant' only when meaning a quantized/compatible build, otherwise use 'model'.

lee: CI bot shows a docs preview link but the deploy failed when building code samples — log: `Error: yarn run docs:build exited 1` — maybe a lint error in the snippet.

ci-bot: preview build started for PR #482 — logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1732123456/build

maria: Found one phrasing nit in migration.md: "you can pin models" -> prefer "pin a model version". Also a heading has sentence case vs Title Case. Should we normalize headings to Title Case per guide?

alex: Yes, headings in the migration guide should be Title Case. Keep inline code monospace and use fenced blocks for longer snippets.

jamal: Re snippet: changed `client.generate({model: 'redwood-v1'})` -> `client.generate({ model: 'redwood-v1' })` and added a short comment about rate limits. Also switched example from callback to async/await to match SDK style.

sophia: A couple of voice points: avoid marketing adjectives in docs (e.g., "fastest"), prefer measurable claims or links to benchmarks. For step-by-step, use imperative: "Create an API key", not "You can create an API key".

maria: Also standardized on the term "Redwood Console" (not "console"). Small but important for search.

alex: Great catches. Lee, can you re-run the preview after jams fixes? I want to merge during the 4pm window.

lee: Re-running now. Docs-bot will post the new preview link.

docs-bot: New preview available: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/PR-482 — please review live examples.

jamal: Live preview shows the code block rendering fine. Found one more: the JS example used `fetch('/v1/generate')` without auth header in the comment — added `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` comment.

maria: I approve the wording changes. Two remaining items: update changelog entry to be present-tense, and add a brief note in migration guide about cache invalidation.

alex: Thanks. I'll add changelog line and the cache note. Anyone opposed to merging at 16:00 UTC?

sophia: No objections from me.

lee: CI green. Preview link updated: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/PR-482?rev=2

ci-bot: all checks passed for PR #482 (lint, build, preview).

alex: Merging in 5. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Follow-up: I'll open a tiny PR to add a lint rule to catch missing auth comments in examples.

maria: :thumbsup:

jamal: Nice. One small TODO: add an explicit example for Dedicated vs Hosted behavior in migration guide later.

alex: Noted — will schedule a follow-up.

lee: Merged. Release note: docs PR #482 merged by alex at 16:02 UTC.

docs-bot: PR #482 merged. Thanks everyone!"
